title: Record the characteristic polynomial over Q(i) of one eigenvalue-i 48-space
body:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->

## Change and mathematical scope

Finite exact computation for one invariant subspace of the historical `c=1` one-slot block. No new kappa. The selected conditional kappa stays `781451/250000000`.

Let `s = (0 4 3 7)(5 6)` with all signs `+1`. On the moved sign character `eps[1] * eps[2]`, the eigenvalue-`i` eigenspace of `s` is 48-dimensional over `Q(i)`. The monic characteristic polynomial of `A_1` on that space lies in `Z[x]` and is

```text
x^10 (x-2)^5 (x+2)^5
  (x^3 - 8x^2 + 4x + 32)
  (x^3 - 12x - 8)
  (x^3 - 12x + 8)
  (x^3 + 8x^2 + 4x - 32)
  (x^8 - 6x^7 - 56x^6 + 296x^5 + 704x^4 - 3264x^3 - 1728x^2 + 7296x - 3072)
  (x^8 + 6x^7 - 56x^6 - 296x^5 + 704x^4 + 3264x^3 - 1728x^2 - 7296x - 3072)
```

Ascending-coefficient SHA256 of `chi_{A_1}` is `248dde5357601a63a3e5b548e370f6025e6cc457204723a43413d2eaa79833e3`. The eigenvalue-`-i` space of the same character is isospectral. Each factor above is irreducible over `Q(i)`. The polynomial is not square-free. Algebraic multiplicity of eigenvalue 0 is 10.

This is a proof by exact linear algebra of one characteristic polynomial. The basis is the full solution of a finite monomial system over `Z[i]`. The polynomial is the exact interpolant of 49 determinants. It is not a minimal polynomial of the full operator, not a geometric multiplicity, and not a census of every invariant subspace.

The same explicit polynomial is the one PR #7036 records for the eigenvalue-`±1` spaces of `eps[5] * eps[6]`. The two statements concern different subspaces. This package recomputes the polynomial on the eigenvalue-`i` space and does not rebuild that matrix.

## Task and overlap

Base commit `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840`. The diff is only `research/c1-moved-48-i-charpoly/`.

Task card `formal-interface-lemma`. Scope status: **changed**. The card asks for a formal caller binding. [PR #7036](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7036) leaves open the characteristic polynomial, over `Q(i)`, of one eigenvalue-`i` eigenspace of `s` on `eps[1] * eps[2]`. The integer basis there solves only the eigenvalues `±1`. This package answers that question. It does not add a Lean binding and does not recompute the eigenvalue-`±1` polynomial.

The query is the frozen interface used by `research/centre-polynomial-cache-limits/`, SHA256 `5c6c51fbffc07a683e922f17532fd90262ae9e23cc3560a696002073dd234ef3`.

Local overlap on 2026-11-10 covered 10178 of 10178 HEAD notes. The phrase hits were unrelated 48-dimensional lattice notes. A GitHub search of open pull requests and discussions for `eigenvalue-i` returned PR #7036, which asks this question, together with the neighboring character-split PRs that do not compute it. The offline overlap cache had no usable remote snapshot. No fork branch already contained this computation.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, standard library only. Both registered modes passed:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/c1-moved-48-i-charpoly
```

Marker `PASS_C1_MOVED_48_I_CHARPOLY`. Metadata check: `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`. Selected-baseline orientation: `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`.

The verifier rebuilds the sign stabilizer, the character `eps[1]*eps[2]`, the eigenvalue-`i` basis, and the matrix of `B = 4 A_1`. The canonical basis and matrix are pinned. Characteristic polynomials are exact Newton interpolants of fraction-free determinants over `Z[i]`, cross-checked modulo `1000003` in `F_p[i]`. Factors are checked by multiplication. Cubics are irreducible over `Q(i)` because they have no integer root. Octics are irreducible over `Q` modulo `1019`, and a conjugate quartic splitting is impossible because the constant term `-3072` is negative. Rejection controls cover a coordinate transposition, a swapped port label, a character-sign flip, the reciprocal `i` in place of `-i`, a one-entry matrix change, a dropped factor, a sign error in a basis vector, and conjugation of a basis vector.

Not run: Lean, Docker, the degree-881 replay, the selected cold replay, and the exact nullity of the pinned matrix.

## Credit

JoyboyBrian recorded the open decomposition question in discussion comment 19144258. PR #7009, by unpaidmoon, recorded `s` and the multiplicity pattern `48^4` without a basis. PR #7036, by unpaidmoon, recorded the eigenvalue-`±1` polynomial and left this eigenvalue-`i` polynomial open. The operators `g` and `t` come from the sign-stabilizer split, PR #6944. Ali Romman's PR4958 and PR4720 retain the query and the Bell action. Nick Petalas's PR5120 is the degree-410 lower bound. Krzysztof Wojt's PR5168 is the degree-881 one-slot annihilator. The doubled representation comes from PR1719. New work is Apache-2.0.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. The assistant derived the basis and checked the polynomial. This is not an independent human or proof-kernel review.

## Open next questions

Recorded in `research/c1-moved-48-i-charpoly/TASK.json`.

- What is the geometric multiplicity of eigenvalue 0 on this pinned eigenvalue-`i` matrix? Algebraic multiplicity is 10. This is not the eigenvalue-`+1` matrix of PR #7036.
- What is the characteristic polynomial, over `Q(i)`, of one eigenvalue-`i` eigenspace of `s` on `eps[5] * eps[6]`?
